tweet_text: @AppleSupport Battery health dropped from 99% to 88% in 3 weeks after updating. Is this normal?
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Standard battery health diagnostic inquiry; non-urgent hardware issue.
reference_resolution: Battery degradation can vary based on usage and charging patterns. You can review battery health in Settings > Battery > Battery Health. If capacity falls below 80% during warranty, service is covered.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport My phone melted its charging port while plugged in overnight! The wire was smoking!!
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Severe safety hazard (hardware melting/smoke) requires immediate human safety protocol escalation.
reference_resolution: We take safety matters very seriously. Please disconnect the charger immediately and do not attempt to power on the device. We are escalating your case to our Senior Safety Specialists.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport screen on iPhone 12 turned completely green after dropping in water. Touch screen unresponsive.
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Physical/water damage hardware repair request needing store appointment/mail-in repair.
reference_resolution: Water resistance can decrease over time and liquid damage is not covered under standard warranty. Please visit an Apple Authorized Service Provider or schedule a store visit at apple.co/RepairStore

tweet_text: @AppleSupport battery drains 50% overnight with zero apps open in background. iOS 17.3.
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Standard software/battery drain query resolved via diagnostic steps.
reference_resolution: Background indexing after an update can temporarily affect battery life. Check Settings > Battery to see active background processes or toggle Low Power Mode.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport Is fast charging bad for long term battery health on iPhone 15 Pro?
reference_resolution: Apple lithium-ion batteries use fast charging to reach 80% capacity quickly, then switch to slower trickle charging to extend battery lifespan. Learn more at apple.co/Batteries

tweet_text: @AppleSupport iOS 17 update crashed mid-way and now shows a black screen with support.apple.com/iphone/restore
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Standard recovery mode issue with clear official resolution URL.
reference_resolution: Your iPhone is in Recovery Mode. Connect your device to a computer via cable, open Finder or iTunes, and choose 'Update' to reinstall iOS without erasing data. Guide: apple.co/RestoreRecovery

tweet_text: @AppleSupport Camera app is completely black when I open it, but flash works. Restarting didn't fix it.
reference_resolution: Make sure no app is locking the camera in the background. Try closing all apps and force restarting your iPhone. If the black screen persists, contact support for a diagnostic check.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport YOUR NEW UPDATE RUINED MY PHONE!! Screen is lagging and freezing every 5 seconds! Fix this now or I'm switching to Samsung!
ground_truth_escalation_reason: High customer frustration/churn risk requires empathetic human advisor handoff.
reference_resolution: We understand how frustrating performance issues are and we want to help make this right. Please DM us your iOS version and device model so an advisor can investigate.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport Siri stops listening halfway through my sentences since updating to iOS 17.2.
reference_resolution: Try resetting Siri by going to Settings > Siri & Search, toggling off 'Listen for Hey Siri', restarting your device, and turning it back on.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport Bluetooth keeps turning off by itself when I lock my phone. Software bug?
reference_resolution: Check if any Focus mode or power-saving profile is managing your Bluetooth connections in Settings > Focus.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport Someone hacked my Apple ID and changed the recovery email address! I'm locked out of everything!
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Account compromise/security breach requiring strict human verification and security team intervention.
reference_resolution: We treat account security with the highest urgency. Please visit iforgot.apple.com immediately or call our security hotline at 1-800-MY-APPLE for immediate account lock verification.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport I forgot my passcode and my iPhone is disabled. How do I get back in?
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Standard passcode lockout resolution via recovery restore.
reference_resolution: If you forgot your passcode, you will need to erase your iPhone using a computer or Find My to reset it. Follow the steps at apple.co/PasscodeReset

tweet_text: @AppleSupport How do I remove an old device from my Apple ID account trusted devices list?
reference_resolution: Sign in at appleid.apple.com or go to Settings > [Your Name] on your iPhone, tap the device you wish to remove, and select 'Remove from Account'.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport Not receiving 2FA SMS code to log into iCloud on my web browser.
reference_resolution: If SMS codes aren't arriving, check your cellular connection or generate a code offline on a trusted Apple device in Settings > [Your Name] > Password & Security.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport I paid for 200GB iCloud storage plan but my phone still says 'Storage Almost Full'!
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Clarification between local device storage vs. cloud storage.
reference_resolution: iCloud storage expands your cloud backup space, but does not increase physical device storage capacity. You can check local storage usage in Settings > General > iPhone Storage.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport All my family photos from 2018 disappeared from iCloud after signing out and back in!
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Potential data loss panic inquiry; requires human support reassurance and database log review.
reference_resolution: Don't worry, your photos are likely still stored safely in the cloud. Ensure 'iCloud Photos' is toggled ON in Settings > Photos. Send us a DM if photos do not begin syncing.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport How do I share an iCloud Photo Album with a non-Apple user?
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Feature inquiry for Public Web Link sharing.
reference_resolution: You can share a Shared Album with anyone by turning on 'Public Website' in the album settings, which creates a web link accessible on any web browser.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport I was billed \$14.99 for a subscription I cancelled 3 days ago. I want a refund now!
reference_resolution: You can submit a refund request directly at reportaproblem.apple.com. Log in with your Apple ID, find the charge, and select 'Request a refund'.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport Why is my payment method declined in App Store when I have plenty of funds?
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Payment authorization / billing block issue requiring account check.
reference_resolution: Payment declination can occur due to bank verification or unpaid balances. Please verify billing details in Settings > [Your Name] > Media & Purchases, or DM us for billing verification.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport My child made 12 unauthorized purchases in Roblox totaling \$300 without my consent!
ground_truth_escalation_reason: High-value disputed charge / parental control issue requiring human billing review.
reference_resolution: We understand how concerning this is. Please visit reportaproblem.apple.com to request refunds for all unauthorized items. To prevent future purchases, enable Screen Time restrictions: apple.co/InAppRestrictions

tweet_text: @AppleSupport My AirPods Pro crackle whenever transparency mode or noise cancellation is turned on.
reference_resolution: Ensure your AirPods firmware and connected device software are up to date. Clean the mesh grilles gently. If static persists, your AirPods may qualify for our service program: apple.co/AirPodsProService

tweet_text: @AppleSupport AirDrop fails every time I try to send photos from iPhone to Mac. Both are on same Wi-Fi.
reference_resolution: Make sure both Bluetooth and Wi-Fi are active on both devices, and set AirDrop visibility to 'Everyone for 10 Minutes' in Control Center.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport My phone is completely frozen and won't turn off. Power button doesn't do anything!
reference_resolution: Perform a force restart: press and quickly release Volume Up, press and quickly release Volume Down, then hold the Side Button until the Apple logo appears.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport Wi-Fi button is greyed out in settings and won't toggle on at all.
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Hardware Wi-Fi chip failure indicator needing physical store diagnostic.
reference_resolution: A greyed-out Wi-Fi setting often points to a hardware component requirement. Try resetting Network Settings first. If unchanged, please schedule a store inspection: apple.co/RepairAppointment

tweet_text: @AppleSupport Apple Watch heart rate monitor stopped tracking during workouts after swimming.
reference_resolution: Make sure Water Lock is disabled by pressing and holding the Digital Crown, and clean the back crystal sensor with a microfiber cloth.

tweet_text: Hey @AppleSupport Phone feels like a heater when playing games and charging at the same time. Is this safe?
reference_resolution: Gaming while fast-charging creates normal thermal buildup. Disconnect charger to cool down.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport quick question: Battery indicator jumps from 40% to 1% and shuts down instantly! HELP!
reference_resolution: Unexpected shutdowns warrant a hardware battery diagnostic at an Apple Store.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport help! Wireless charging pad stopped working with my MagSafe case yesterday.
reference_resolution: Ensure your case is MagSafe certified and remove any metal rings or credit cards between phone and charger.

tweet_text: @AppleSupport App icons missing after iOS update! How do I restore them?
reference_resolution: Swipe left to the App Library to relocate missing apps or reset Home Screen Layout in Settings.

tweet_text: Ugh @AppleSupport Screen freeze on incoming calls, can't tap accept or decline!
ground_truth_escalation_reason: Critical telephony bug interrupting incoming calls.
